title: Native Getter and Readback Directory Evidence Ledger

claims.statement: All essential Coach, Roster, Contract, Draft, Scouting, and Player decision inputs and post-execution readback paths have exact RVA and structure offsets mapped directly to binary routines in NBA2K22.exe.
claims.falsification_note: Getters provide raw unpadded native values; callers must translate enums and bitfields.
